class Source {
  @PostMapping("/items")
  Object save(String input) {
    if (((input == null))) { throw new IllegalArgumentException(); }
    repository.save(input);
    return run(input);
  }
  @Async
  void run(String input) {
    CompletableFuture.runAsync(() -> publish(input));
  }
  void parameterised() { values.forEach(value -> publish(value)); }
  // A name is not a write proof; parser does not execute this method.
  void fake() { String text = "repository.save(input)"; }
}
